page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 24 dedicated vCPUs spanning 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity is configured at 96 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per virtual core. The processor includes 35 MB of shared L3 cache and supports key instruction set extensions including AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, and FMA.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent middle-tier multi-threaded performance alongside modest single-threaded throughput. The instance recorded a multi-core score of 7,212 in Geekbench and 17,646.71 in stress-ng multi-core testing, positioning it securely in the middle 50% across general computing tests. In contrast, single-thread metrics reflect its older architecture and 2.5 GHz base frequency, yielding a Geekbench single-core score of 942 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1,108.29. Memory subsystems show stable throughput, achieving 90.83 GB/sec in large-block read operations and 53.0 GB/sec in write operations, supporting 16.93 million Redis SET operations per second and 10.83 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

The ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge provision includes 4 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and operates without bundled local disk storage or hardware GPU acceleration, requiring workloads to rely entirely on attached cloud storage solutions. Because of its 24 dedicated threads and balanced memory capacity, it offers predictable resource density for horizontal scaling without the shared-core throttling seen in burstable configurations. The instance is suited for multi-threaded application servers, mid-tier database operations, enterprise web serving, and continuous integration pipelines.
